info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Prioritys-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Prioritization API enables users to retrieve a list of available priority levels for support tickets. This endpoint is particularly beneficial for customer service teams managing workflows, allowing them to classify and prioritize incoming tickets effectively. Typical consumers include support agents and application developers who integrate ticket management functionalities into their systems. Through this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency in handling customer inquiries.

get.summary: Retrieve the priority levels of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the different priority levels assigned to tickets. It can be used to categorize support requests or tasks based on their urgency and importance, enabling better resource allocation and response management.
